preconditions.description: The number of lines in the file must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each line must contain between 0 and 100,000 characters.
The starting and ending line numbers must be valid indices within the range of lines.
The starting and ending cursor positions must be valid within their respective lines.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of key presses required to move the cursor from (r_1, c_1) to (r_2, c_2).
